title: hbench dataset source descriptor, v1
description: The source.yaml that `hbench datasets pack`, `push` and `convert` read: what the dataset's config blob and manifest say beyond its tasks, and what its task directories must be. It accepts every descriptor of node-q/hbench-datasets' schema/source.v1.json, and needs only schema_version, name, version and license. The fields that reach the config blob take what assets/schemas/dataset-config.v1.json takes; the other fields keep source.v1's rules.

name.description: Dataset name: the last component of its OCI repository, and the <name> in -d <name>@<version>.

version.description: Dataset version: semver without build metadata, the patch number optional. It is the manifest's tag.

description.description: The config's description, and the manifest's org.opencontainers.image.description.

license.description: SPDX licence expression covering the task directories as published.

upstream.description: The dataset this version is derived from; the config's upstream.

canary.description: The canary string the dataset's files carry; the config's canary.

source.description: The git repository and commit the task directories were taken from: the manifest's org.opencontainers.image.source and .revision. hbench refuses to pack any other number of tasks than task_count.

environment.description: How the tasks reference their prebuilt images. hbench checks each task.toml's docker_image against declared_image ({task} standing for the task directory's name) and, for pinned-by-digest, against images.
